description:
We are Gelber Group -- Passion for Trading. Powered by Technology. 

 For more than 40 years, Gelber has been one of the industry's leading proprietary trading firms, combining entrepreneurial thinking with disciplined execution. Headquartered in Chicago, with offices and remote team members throughout the United States and Europe, we have built a reputation for innovation, longevity, and consistent performance. Through regulated businesses that include a FINRA-registered broker-dealer, a self-clearing Chicago Mercantile Exchange member firm, and an AFM-licensed MiFID II investment firm, Gelber is positioned to trade across all major global financial markets.

 Our business is driven by a relentless pursuit of new trading opportunities and a deep commitment to technical excellence. We trade a diverse range of asset classes and financial instruments using strategies that span the full spectrum of trading—from high-frequency and systematic approaches to longer-term discretionary trading. This diversity creates an intellectually rich environment where ideas, perspectives, and expertise from across the firm contribute to our continued evolution.

 Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and meritocratic. We empower talented people to take ownership, contribute meaningfully, and make an impact early in their careers. We believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage, and we invest in their development by providing meaningful responsibility, exceptional colleagues, and the resources they need to succeed

 The Opportunity

 As a Software Engineer at Gelber Securities, LLC, you will work directly with a successful trading desk that trades derivatives listed on the U.S. markets. You will work side by side with experienced traders, quants, and other talented engineers to design, develop, and support systems and applications used by both human and algorithmic traders, having a direct and meaningful impact on PnL. An amazing opportunity to learn and grow from a team of intelligent and skilled individuals. This role is for someone who flourishes in a fast-paced environment, has a strong work ethic, clear communication, and a very strong interest in working at a trading firm.

 This position can either sit in our Chicago Headquarters office or remote within the United States. 

 What you’ll do: 

 
 Communicate with engineers, traders, and quants to architect, design, develop, deploy, and support our proprietary trading applications and tools

 Have a significant impact in development for our existing infrastructure in C#, as well as adding new features and applications for our human and algorithmic traders

 Become an expert in the entire trading pipeline and the software and technology that it is built upon, including the back end, front end, and everything in between

 Provide real time support and bug fixes for live trading applications

 
 What you’ll need: 

 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field

 3+ years of work experience working in C#, Java, or C++

 Strong understanding of and experience with an Object Oriented Programming language

 Excellent communication skills specifically when it comes to understanding requirements and translating that into code and fixing bugs

 Self-motivation and ability to work with others in a remote environment

 Understanding of the financial markets is not required, but preferred and must have a strong interest

 Working knowledge of Options, Volatility, and SQL not required but is a plus

 
  

 Compensation and Benefits

 The approximate annual base salary for this position in Chicago, Illinois/Nationwide is $100,000 to $150,000. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package plus benefits, will be determined by a number of factors which include but are not limited to the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities; geographic location; and internal equity. In addition to your salary, our total rewards package includes health benefits, a 401(k) plan, PTO, parental leave, professional development, tuition reimbursement and discretionary bonus, enhancing your overall total rewards package. 

 Gelber offers a wide range of benefits to full-time employees, including:

 
 Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement program with discretionary employer match

 Comprehensive health benefits including medical coverage provided by Blue Cross and Blue Shield (PPO and HDHP/HSA) and dental coverage; generous employer cost-sharing

 Tuition reimbursement for Undergraduate and Graduate courses

 Flexible Spending Accounts for health care and dependent care; pre-tax commuter benefits for parking and transit expenses

 Life insurance and long-term disability coverage

 Health club membership with on-site facilities (and reciprocal memberships)

 Generous vacation time (23-day accrual in first full calendar year of employment; prorated accrual in initial year), paid holidays, and paid maternity/paternity leave

 Weekly catered lunches and monthly continental breakfasts (Chicago Headquarters Only)

 Social events including sponsored 5k races and annual company party 

 Enjoyable work environment including golf simulator

 Employee referral bonus program

 Charitable giving and company matching opportunities

 Casual, relaxed dress code
